title: Designing Toxic Content Classification for a Diversity of Perspectives
findings: Religion has one of the strongest influences on how participants perceive toxic content. The odds that a participant rates a comment as toxic increase by 1.840 times if they consider religion 'Very important'. This effect persists even for those who consider religion 'Not too important' (1.216 times increase in odds). Religious participants were also more likely to classify comments into all toxic subcategories, with the largest increases for profanity and threats.
